title.en: Fable 14 — The Farmer and the Snake

sentences.ar: فلاح لقي حية نص ميتة من البرد.
sentences.en: A farmer found a snake half dead from the cold.
He put it in his shirt to warm it.
The snake warmed up and grew strong.

sentences.ar: قال وهو عم يموت: أنا الغلطان.
sentences.en: He said as he was dying: I am the one at fault.
